component.name: asterisk
component.title: Asterisk
component.description: Receive events from an Asterisk PBX server and send actions to it over the Asterisk Manager Interface (AMI).
component.label: mobile

bridgeErrorHandler.label: consumer
bridgeErrorHandler.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelAsteriskEventName.label: consumer
CamelAsteriskEventName.description: The simple class name of the asterisk-java ManagerEvent in the body, for example NewChannelEvent or HangupEvent. Set by the consumer for each event.

CamelAsteriskExtension.label: producer
CamelAsteriskExtension.description: The extension whose state the producer queries with the EXTENSION_STATE action, for example 100. The other actions do not use it.

CamelAsteriskContext.label: producer
CamelAsteriskContext.description: The dialplan context that contains the extension of the CamelAsteriskExtension header, for the EXTENSION_STATE action. The other actions do not use it.

CamelAsteriskAction.label: producer
CamelAsteriskAction.description: The AMI action that the producer sends for this message. Replaces the action option.

consumerOut.description: The AMI event: a subclass of ManagerEvent such as NewChannelEvent or HangupEvent, with its simple class name in the CamelAsteriskEventName header. The ConnectEvent of the login comes first

producerIn.description: The body is not read: the action comes from the action option or the CamelAsteriskAction header, and the extension and context of EXTENSION_STATE from the CamelAsteriskExtension and CamelAsteriskContext headers

producerOut.description: QUEUE_STATUS and SIP_PEERS give the ResponseEvents of asterisk-java: the ManagerResponse in getResponse() and the events of the list in getEvents(), such as QueueParamsEvent and QueueMemberEvent or PeerEntryEvent, ending with the complete event. EXTENSION_STATE gives the ManagerResponse, an ExtensionStateResponse. A ManagerError is the response when Asterisk answers with an error

name.description: A logical name of the endpoint, for example the name of the Asterisk server. The component does not use it to connect.

hostname.description: The host name or IP address of the Asterisk server. The consumer and the producer connect to the Asterisk Manager Interface (AMI) of this host on the port of the port option.

port.description: The port of the Asterisk Manager Interface (AMI) of the Asterisk server, as set in the manager.conf file of the server.

exceptionHandler.label: consumer,advanced
exceptionHandler.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exchangePattern.label: consumer,advanced
exchangePattern.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

action.label: producer
action.description: The AMI action that the producer sends for each message: QUEUE_STATUS for the status of the queues and their members, SIP_PEERS for the list of SIP peers, or EXTENSION_STATE for the state of the extension in the CamelAsteriskExtension and CamelAsteriskContext headers. The CamelAsteriskAction header replaces this option for a message. If neither is set, the producer fails the message.

password.label: security
password.description: The secret of the AMI user, as defined in the manager.conf file of the Asterisk server.

username.label: security
username.description: The name of the AMI user, as defined in the manager.conf file of the Asterisk server. The consumer and the producer each log in with it when they start.
